core_step: List files in the working directory and target 'all' folder
why_essential: To discover the repository structure and locate the folder containing the 103 unorganized files to be classified.

core_step: Count and list filenames in /root/papers/all to get the complete file inventory
why_essential: A complete inventory is required to ensure every file is examined and ultimately moved into one of the five subject folders.
evidence: ls /root/papers/all/ | wc -l && ls /root/papers/all/ -> 103 and list of filenames

core_step: Extract first-page text from each PDF using pdftotext to identify subject matter
why_essential: Reading the first page of each PDF provides the title/abstract keywords needed to classify each paper into the correct subject folder.
evidence: pdftotext -l 1 "$f" - 2>/dev/null | head -20 ... showed content e.g. 'Tight-binding modeling of charge migration in DNA devices'

core_step: Extract textual content from .docx files by reading document.xml inside the docx ZIP
why_essential: Docx files don't respond to pdftotext; extracting document.xml is required to read their content and classify them correctly.
evidence: python3 ... with zipfile.ZipFile(fname, 'r') as z: ... printed 'Dear Editor, We are submitting our manuscript titled "Temporally multiplexed ion-photon quantum interface via fast ion-chain transport"'

core_step: Extract slide text from DAMOP.pptx by reading slide XML inside the pptx ZIP
why_essential: PPTX files must be inspected by unpacking slide XML to determine the subject (e.g., trapped-ion quantum interface) for correct folder placement.
evidence: with zipfile.ZipFile('DAMOP.pptx', 'r') ... showed 'Temporally multiplexed ion-photon quantum interface Bingran You ...'

core_step: Create the five destination folders: LLM, trapped_ion_and_qc, black_hole, DNA, music_history
why_essential: Destination folders must exist to move each file into its appropriate subject folder without renaming or altering files.

core_step: Move each file into the appropriate subject folder based on extracted content
why_essential: Physically relocating files into the subject folders completes the organization task; each file must be placed in exactly one folder.
evidence: mv ... (commands moving groups of filenames) resulted in folder counts shown below

core_step: Verify that all files have been moved and report counts per folder
why_essential: Verification confirms that no files remain in the source folder and that the total number of files equals the original inventory.
evidence: echo "=== Counts per folder ===" && for f in LLM ...; do ls -1 /root/papers/$f | wc -l; done -> LLM: 20 ... Total: 103

core_step: Provide a summary confirmation that all 103 files were organized into the five folders
why_essential: A final confirmation ensures the task is complete and communicates the successful organization result.
evidence: All 103 files have been organized successfully. Here's a summary: ... Total: 103
